**Finding submitted — EXCLUSIVITY: deviation (preferred cure).**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** the first § 2.2 (p0013, sole-and-exclusive provider), § 12.3 (p0049, freedom-of-supply/no-exclusivity acknowledgement), plus searches for "exclusive", "sole supplier", "procure", "requirements from" — the other "exclusive" hits (§§ 19.4, 21.4, 28.2, 30.2) concern remedies and forum, not dealing restrictions.
- **Classification:** § 2.2 binds Customer to a full-term sole-supplier arrangement for hosted analytics with no category limit, no 12-month cap and no performance-based exit — walk-away territory, failing every fallback element. § 12.3 is countervailing but is directly contradicted by the operative grant, so it cannot be treated as curing it.
- **Cure:** one surgical replace making the appointment non-exclusive and confirming no exclusivity/sole-supplier obligation, which conforms § 2.2 to § 12.3 and meets the single preferred element; the fallback (defined category, 12 months, automatic SLA/delivery-date exit) is offered in the comment as a negotiation position.
